lean.statement:
theorem prob_union_comm (A B : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_union A B) = prob (ev_union B A) := by
lean.proof:
have h₁ := prob_union (prob := prob) A B
  have h₂ := prob_union (prob := prob) B A
  have hcap : prob (ev_inter A B) = prob (ev_inter B A) := by
    have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter A B) (B := ev_inter B A) (ev_inter_comm A B)
    exact this
  have hunion : prob (ev_union A B) = prob (ev_union B A) := by
    exact prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_union A B) (B := ev_union B A) (ev_union_comm A B)
  exact hunion

coq.statement:
Lemma prob_union_comm A B :
    prob (ev_union A B) = prob (ev_union B A).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    apply prob_ext; intro w; split; intro HU; destruct HU as [HA|HB];
    [right|left|right|left]; assumption.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem prob_union_idem (A : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_union A A) = prob A := by
lean.proof:
have h := prob_union (prob := prob) A A
  -- (A ∧ A) ↔ A, written as a pure term (no `by`)
  have hAA : ∀ ω, ev_inter A A ω ↔ A ω :=
    fun ω => Iff.intro (fun h => h.left) (fun h => And.intro h h)
  have hcap : prob (ev_inter A A) = prob A :=
    prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter A A) (B := A) hAA
  have h2 : rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob A)) = rR.zero := rR.add_opp (prob A)
  have h3 : rR.add (prob A) (rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob A))) = rR.add (prob A) rR.zero := by simp [h2]
  have h4 : rR.add (prob A) rR.zero = prob A := rR.add_zero (prob A)
  have : prob (ev_union A A) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob A))) := by
    simpa [hcap]
    using h
  simpa [h3, h4]

coq.statement: Lemma prob_union_idem A : prob (ev_union A A) = prob A.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    specialize (prob_union A A). intro HU.
    assert (Heq : prob (ev_inter A A) = prob A).
    { apply prob_ext; intro w; split; intro HX; [exact (proj1 HX)|split; [exact HX|exact HX]]. }
    rewrite HU. rewrite Heq.
    rewrite add_opp. rewrite add_zero. reflexivity.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem prob_diff (A B : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_diff A B) = prob A -R prob (ev_inter A B) := by
lean.proof:
have hpart : ∀ ω, (A ω) ↔ (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ω := by
    intro ω; constructor
    · intro hA
      have hb := em (B ω)
      cases hb with
      | inl hB => exact Or.inl ⟨hA, hB⟩
      | inr hB => exact Or.inr ⟨hA, hB⟩
    · intro hU; cases hU with
      | inl hAB => exact hAB.left
      | inr hAcB => exact hAcB.left
  have hcap_disj : ∀ ω, (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ω ↔ False := by
    intro ω; constructor <;> intro h
    · rcases h with ⟨hAB, hAcB⟩; exact hAcB.right hAB.right
    · cases h
  have hAeq := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := A) (B := ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) hpart
  have hcap0 : prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) = rR.zero := by
    have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (B := ev_false) hcap_disj
    simpa [prob_false] using this
  have h := prob_union (prob := prob) (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))
  have hsumA : prob A = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) := by
    have : prob A = prob (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) := by
      simpa using hAeq
    have hU := h
    have hzero_opp : rR.opp (prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)))) = rR.opp rR.zero := by
      simp [hcap0]
    have hopp0 : rR.opp rR.zero = rR.zero := opp_zero
    simpa [this, hzero_opp, hopp0, rR.add_assoc, rR.add_zero]
      using hU
  have heq_diff : prob (ev_diff A B) = prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) := by
    exact prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_diff A B) (B := ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) (by intro ω; constructor <;> intro h; exact h; exact h)
  have hsub : rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))
              = prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) := by
    calc
      rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))
          = rR.add (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) := by
              simp [hsumA]
      _ = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))) := by
              simpa using (rR.add_assoc (prob (ev_inter A B)) (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))))
      _ = rR.add (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))) (prob (ev_inter A B)) := by
              simpa using (rR.add_comm (prob (ev_inter A B)) (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))))
      _ = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.add (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) (prob (ev_inter A B))) := by
              simpa using (rR.add_assoc (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) (prob (ev_inter A B)))
      _ = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))) := by
              have := rR.add_comm (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) (prob (ev_inter A B))
              simpa using congrArg (fun t => rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) t) this
      _ = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) rR.zero := by
              simp [rR.add_opp]
      _ = prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) := by
              simp [rR.add_zero]
  simpa [heq_diff] using hsub.symm

coq.statement: Lemma prob_diff A B : prob (ev_diff A B) = prob A -R prob (ev_inter A B).
coq.proof:
assert (Hpart : forall w, A w <-> (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) w).
    { intro w. split.
      - intro hA. destruct (classic (B w)) as [hB|hNB].
        + left. split; assumption.
        + right. split; assumption.
      - intros [ [hA _] | [hA _] ]; exact hA. }
    assert (Hcap0 : prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) = zero).
    { rewrite (prob_ext (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ev_false).
      - apply prob_false.
      - intro w. split; intro Hcap; [destruct Hcap as [[? ?] [? Hnb]]; contradiction| contradiction]. }
    pose proof (prob_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) as Hunion.
    (* Replace prob A by the union decomposition *)
    rewrite (prob_ext A (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) Hpart).
    (* Expand prob (union) and simplify empty intersection *)
    rewrite Hunion. rewrite Hcap0. rewrite opp_zero.
    (* Now RHS is (pAB + (pA¬B + 0)) - pAB = pA¬B *)
    rewrite add_zero.
    (* Rearrange to cancel pAB *)
    rewrite add_comm with (x:=prob (ev_inter A B)) (y:=prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))).
    rewrite add_assoc.
    rewrite add_opp. rewrite add_zero.
    (* Replace diff by intersection with complement *)
    unfold ev_diff. apply prob_ext. intro w. split; intro HX; exact HX.

lean.statement:
theorem bayes_symm (A B : event Ω) :
  rR.mul (cprob A B) (prob B) = rR.mul (cprob B A) (prob A) := by
lean.proof:
calc
    rR.mul (cprob A B) (prob B) = prob (ev_inter A B) := by simpa using (cprob_mul (prob := prob) A B).symm
    _ = prob (ev_inter B A) := by
          have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter A B) (B := ev_inter B A) (ev_inter_comm A B)
          simpa using this
    _ = rR.mul (cprob B A) (prob A) := by simpa using (cprob_mul (prob := prob) B A)

coq.statement: Lemma bayes_symm A B : cprob A B *R prob B = cprob B A *R prob A.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    rewrite <- cprob_mul. apply eq_trans with (y:=prob (ev_inter B A)).
    - apply prob_ext; intro w; split; intro HBA; destruct HBA as [h1 h2]; [split; [exact h2|exact h1]|split; [exact h2|exact h1]].
    - apply cprob_mul.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem law_total_prob (A B : event Ω) :
  prob A = rR.add (rR.mul (cprob A B) (prob B)) (rR.mul (cprob A (ev_compl B)) (prob (ev_compl B))) := by
lean.proof:
have hpart : ∀ ω, (A ω) ↔ (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ω := by
    intro ω; constructor
    · intro hA; cases em (B ω) with
      | inl hB => exact Or.inl ⟨hA, hB⟩
      | inr hB => exact Or.inr ⟨hA, hB⟩
    · intro hU; cases hU with
      | inl hAB  => exact hAB.left
      | inr hAcB => exact hAcB.left
  have hAeq := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := A) (B := ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) hpart
  have hcap0 : prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) = rR.zero := by
    have : ∀ ω, (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ω ↔ False := by
      intro ω; constructor <;> intro h
      · rcases h with ⟨hAB, hAcB⟩; exact hAcB.right hAB.right
      · cases h
    have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (B := ev_false) this
    simpa [prob_false] using this
  have h := prob_union (prob := prob) (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))
  have hsumA : prob A = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) := by
    have : prob A = prob (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) := by
      simpa using hAeq
    have hU := h
    have hzero_opp : rR.opp (prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)))) = rR.opp rR.zero := by
      simp [hcap0]
    have hopp0 : rR.opp rR.zero = rR.zero := opp_zero
    simpa [this, hzero_opp, hopp0, rR.add_assoc, rR.add_zero]
      using hU
  simp [hsumA, cprob_mul (prob := prob) A B, cprob_mul (prob := prob) A (ev_compl B)]

coq.statement:
Lemma law_total_prob A B :
    prob A = cprob A B *R prob B +R cprob A (ev_compl B) *R prob (ev_compl B).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    pose proof (prob_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) as Hunion.
    assert (Hpart : forall w, A w <-> (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) w).
    { intro w. split.
      - intro hA. destruct (classic (B w)) as [hB|hNB].
        + left. split; assumption.
        + right. split; assumption.
      - intros [ [hA _] | [hA _] ]; exact hA. }
    rewrite (prob_ext A (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) Hpart).
    rewrite Hunion.
    assert (Hcap0 : prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) = zero).
    { rewrite (prob_ext (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ev_false).
      - apply prob_false.
      - intro w. split; intro Hcap; [destruct Hcap as [[? ?] [? Hnb]]; contradiction| contradiction]. }
    rewrite Hcap0. rewrite opp_zero. rewrite add_zero.
    rewrite cprob_mul. rewrite cprob_mul. reflexivity.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem prob_union_indep (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B →
  prob (ev_union A B) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.add (prob B) (rR.opp (rR.mul (prob A) (prob B)))) := by
lean.proof:
intro hI
  have hU := prob_union (prob := prob) A B
  have hIeq : prob (ev_inter A B) = rR.mul (prob A) (prob B) := hI
  simpa [hIeq] using hU

coq.statement:
Lemma prob_union_indep A B : indep A B ->
    prob (ev_union A B) = prob A +R (prob B +R -R (prob A *R prob B)).
coq.proof: Proof. intro Hin. unfold indep in Hin. rewrite prob_union. now rewrite Hin. Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem indep_compl_right (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) A (ev_compl B) := by
lean.proof:
intro hI
  have hdiff := prob_diff (prob := prob) A B
  have heq_diff : prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) := by
    have hset : prob (ev_diff A B) = prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) :=
      prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_diff A B) (B := ev_inter A (ev_compl B))
        (by intro ω; constructor <;> intro h <;> exact h)
    simpa [hset] using hdiff
  have hIeq : prob (ev_inter A B) = rR.mul (prob A) (prob B) := hI
  have hlhs : prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (rR.mul (prob A) (prob B))) := by
    simpa [hIeq]
      using heq_diff
  have hdist : rR.add (rR.mul (prob A) rR.one) (rR.mul (prob A) (rR.opp (prob B)))
                = rR.mul (prob A) (rR.add rR.one (rR.opp (prob B))) := by
    simpa using (rR.dist_l (prob A) rR.one (rR.opp (prob B))).symm
  have hmul1 : rR.mul (prob A) rR.one = prob A := rR.mul_one (prob A)
  have hmul2 : rR.mul (prob A) (rR.opp (prob B)) = rR.opp (rR.mul (prob A) (prob B)) := by
    simpa using (opp_mul_right (prob A) (prob B))
  have halg : rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (rR.mul (prob A) (prob B)))
              = rR.mul (prob A) (rR.add rR.one (rR.opp (prob B))) := by
    simpa [hmul1, hmul2] using hdist
  have : prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) = rR.mul (prob A) (prob (ev_compl B)) := by
    simpa [prob_compl (prob := prob) B, halg] using hlhs
  exact this

coq.statement: Lemma indep_compl_right A B : indep A B -> indep A (ev_compl B).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intro Hin. unfold indep.
    (* Convert intersection with complement to set difference *)
    assert (HeqID : prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) = prob (ev_diff A B)).
    { apply prob_ext. intro w. split; intro Hw; exact Hw. }
    rewrite HeqID.
    (* Use difference identity and independence *)
    rewrite prob_diff. rewrite Hin.
    (* Compute complement probability and distribute *)
    rewrite prob_compl. rewrite dist_l. rewrite mul_one. rewrite opp_mul_right. reflexivity.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem indep_symm (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) B A := by
lean.proof:
intro hI
  unfold indep at hI
  unfold indep
  have hcap : prob (ev_inter B A) = prob (ev_inter A B) := by
    have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter B A) (B := ev_inter A B) (ev_inter_comm B A)
    simpa using this
  have hmul : rR.mul (prob A) (prob B) = rR.mul (prob B) (prob A) := by
    simpa using (rR.mul_comm (prob A) (prob B))
  calc
    prob (ev_inter B A) = prob (ev_inter A B) := hcap
    _ = rR.mul (prob A) (prob B) := hI
    _ = rR.mul (prob B) (prob A) := by simpa using hmul

coq.statement: Lemma indep_symm A B : indep A B -> indep B A.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intro Hin. unfold indep in *.
    rewrite (prob_ext (ev_inter B A) (ev_inter A B)).
    - rewrite mul_comm. exact Hin.
    - intro w. split; intro Hba; destruct Hba as [h1 h2]; [split; [exact h2|exact h1]|split; [exact h2|exact h1]].
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem indep_compl_left (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) (ev_compl A) B := by
lean.proof:
intro hI
  have hBA : indep (prob := prob) B A := indep_symm (prob := prob) A B hI
  have hBnotA : indep (prob := prob) B (ev_compl A) :=
    indep_compl_right (prob := prob) B A hBA
  exact indep_symm (prob := prob) B (ev_compl A) hBnotA

coq.statement: Lemma indep_compl_left A B : indep A B -> indep (ev_compl A) B.
coq.proof: Proof. intro Hin. apply indep_symm. apply indep_symm in Hin. now apply indep_compl_right. Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem prob_bigUnion_disjoint
  (xs : mylist (event Ω))
  (hp : pairwise_disjoint xs) :
  prob (bigUnion xs)
    = mylist.fold_add rR.add rR.zero (mylist.mapL prob xs) := by
lean.proof:
revert hp
  induction xs with
  | nilL =>
      intro _
      simp [bigUnion, mylist.fold_add, mylist.mapL, prob_false]
  | consL A xs ih =>
      intro hp
      cases xs with
      | nilL =>
          have hunionA : prob (ev_union A ev_false) = prob A :=
            prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_union A ev_false) (B := A)
              (by
                intro ω; constructor
                · intro h; cases h with
                  | inl hA => exact hA
                  | inr hf => exact False.elim hf
                · intro hA; exact Or.inl hA)
          simp [bigUnion, mylist.fold_add, mylist.mapL, rR.add_zero, hunionA]
      | consL B xs' =>
          rcases hp with ⟨hAB, hrest, hpw⟩
          have hAdisj : disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs')) :=
            disjoint_head_tail A (B ::L xs') (by
              exact And.intro hAB (And.intro hrest hpw))
          have hU' :
              prob (bigUnion (A ::L (B ::L xs'))) =
              rR.add (prob A) (prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs'))) := by
            simpa [bigUnion] using
              (prob_union_disjoint (prob := prob) A (bigUnion (B ::L xs')) hAdisj)
          have htail :
              prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs')) =
              mylist.fold_add rR.add rR.zero (mylist.mapL prob (B ::L xs')) :=
            ih hpw
          have hsum :
              prob (bigUnion (A ::L (B ::L xs'))) =
              rR.add (prob A)
                (mylist.fold_add rR.add rR.zero (mylist.mapL prob (B ::L xs'))) := by
            simpa [htail] using hU'
          simpa [bigUnion, mylist.mapL, mylist.fold_add, rR.add_assoc] using hsum

coq.statement:
Lemma prob_bigUnion_disjoint : forall xs,
    pairwise_disjoint xs -> prob (bigUnion xs) = fold_add (mapL prob xs).
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros xs HPD.
    induction HPD as [
      | A
      | A B xs Hdisj Hrest HPW IH
    ].
    - simpl. apply prob_false.
    - simpl.
      assert (Hun : prob (ev_union A ev_false) = prob A).
      { apply prob_ext. intro w. split; intro HU;
        [destruct HU as [hA|hF]; [assumption|contradiction] | now left]. }
      simpl. rewrite Hun. rewrite add_zero. reflexivity.
    -
      assert (HAd : disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs))).
      { apply disjoint_head_tail. constructor; assumption. }
      change (prob (ev_union A (bigUnion (B ::L xs))) = prob A +R fold_add (mapL prob (B ::L xs))).
      rewrite (prob_union_disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs)) HAd).
      rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  Qed.

lean.statement:
theorem prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero
  (xs : mylist (event Ω))
  (hp : pairwise_disjoint xs)
  (hzero : ∀ A, InL A xs → prob A = rR.zero) :
  prob (bigUnion xs) = rR.zero := by
lean.proof:
revert hp hzero
  induction xs with
  | nilL =>
      intro _ _
      simp [bigUnion, prob_false]
  | consL A xs ih =>
      intro hp hzero
      cases xs with
      | nilL =>
          have hA0 : prob A = ring.zero := hzero A (InL.In_head _)
          have hunionA : prob (ev_union A ev_false) = prob A :=
            prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_union A ev_false) (B := A)
              (by
                intro ω; constructor
                · intro h; cases h with
                  | inl hA => exact hA
                  | inr hf => exact False.elim hf
                · intro hA; exact Or.inl hA)
          simp [bigUnion, hunionA, hA0]
      | consL B xs' =>
          rcases hp with ⟨hAB, hrest, hpw⟩
          have hAdisj : disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs')) :=
            disjoint_head_tail A (B ::L xs') (by exact And.intro hAB (And.intro hrest hpw))
          have hA0 : prob A = rR.zero := hzero A (InL.In_head _)
          have htail0 : ∀ C, InL C (B ::L xs') → prob C = rR.zero := by
            intro C hC; exact hzero C (InL.In_tail (y := A) (xs := B ::L xs') hC)
          have htail : prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs')) = rR.zero := ih hpw htail0
          have hU :
            prob (bigUnion (A ::L (B ::L xs'))) =
            rR.add (prob A) (prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs'))) := by
            simpa [bigUnion] using
              (prob_union_disjoint (prob := prob) A (bigUnion (B ::L xs')) hAdisj)
          have hsum00 :
            rR.add (prob A) (prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs'))) =
            rR.add rR.zero rR.zero := by
            simp [hA0, htail]
          have : prob (bigUnion (A ::L (B ::L xs'))) =
                rR.add rR.zero rR.zero := by
            simpa [hsum00] using hU
          have hz : rR.add rR.zero rR.zero = rR.zero := by
            simp [rR.add_zero]
          simp [this, hz]

coq.statement:
Lemma prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero : forall xs,
    pairwise_disjoint xs -> (forall A, InL A xs -> prob A = zero) -> prob (bigUnion xs) = zero.
coq.proof:
Proof.
    intros xs HPD HZ.
    induction HPD as [
      | A
      | A B xs Hdisj Hrest HPW IH
    ].
    - simpl. apply prob_false.
    - simpl.
      assert (Hun : prob (ev_union A ev_false) = prob A).
      { apply prob_ext. intro w. split; intro HU;
        [destruct HU as [hA|hF]; [assumption|contradiction] | now left]. }
      rewrite Hun. apply HZ. constructor.
    -
      assert (HAd : disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs))).
      { apply disjoint_head_tail. constructor; assumption. }
      change (prob (ev_union A (bigUnion (B ::L xs))) = zero).
      rewrite (prob_union_disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs)) HAd).
      (* prob A = 0 from HZ on head *)
      rewrite (HZ A (@In_head event A (B ::L xs))).
      (* reduce 0 + prob (bigUnion tail) *)
      rewrite add_comm with (x:=zero) (y:=prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs))).
      rewrite add_zero.
      (* now use IH for the tail with restricted hypothesis *)
      apply IH. intros C Hin. apply HZ. apply In_tail; assumption.
  Qed.

  · rcases h with ⟨hAB, hC⟩; rcases hAB with ⟨hA, hB⟩; exact ⟨hA, ⟨hB, hC⟩⟩
  · rcases h with ⟨hA, hBC⟩; rcases hBC with ⟨hB, hC⟩; exact ⟨⟨hA, hB⟩, hC⟩

  · rcases h with h | h
    · rcases h with hA | hB
      · exact Or.inl hA
      · exact Or.inr (Or.inl hB)
    · exact Or.inr (Or.inr h)
  · rcases h with hA | hBC
    · exact Or.inl (Or.inl hA)
    · rcases hBC with hB | hC

      · exact Or.inr hC

    · exact Or.inl ⟨hA, hB⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hA, hC⟩
  · rcases h with hAB | hAC
    · rcases hAB with ⟨hA, hB⟩; exact ⟨hA, Or.inl hB⟩

prob_union_comm.content:
theorem prob_union_comm (A B : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_union A B) = prob (ev_union B A) := by
  have h₁ := prob_union (prob := prob) A B
  have h₂ := prob_union (prob := prob) B A
  -- Use commutativity of add and symmetry of intersection
  have hcap : prob (ev_inter A B) = prob (ev_inter B A) := by
    have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter A B) (B := ev_inter B A) (ev_inter_comm A B)
    exact this
  -- rewrite RHS using commutativity of add and hcap
  -- Explicit rearrangement using ring axioms
  -- LHS and RHS are equal since union is symmetric
  -- We can show by rewriting h₂ with commutativity
  -- Use the fact ev_union A B ≡ ev_union B A by logic
  have hunion : prob (ev_union A B) = prob (ev_union B A) := by
    exact prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_union A B) (B := ev_union B A) (ev_union_comm A B)
  exact hunion

-- Idempotence: P(A ∪ A) = P(A)

prob_union_idem.content:
theorem prob_union_idem (A : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_union A A) = prob A := by
  -- P(A ∪ A) = P(A) + P(A) - P(A∩A) and A∩A ≡ A
  have h := prob_union (prob := prob) A A
  have hcap : prob (ev_inter A A) = prob A := by
    have : prob (ev_inter A A) = prob A :=
      prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter A A) (B := A)
        (by
          intro ω; constructor
          · intro h; exact h.left
          · intro h; exact And.intro h h)
    simpa using this
  -- Simplify: P(A)+P(A) - P(A) = P(A)
  have h2 : rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob A)) = rR.zero := rR.add_opp (prob A)
  have h3 : rR.add (prob A) (rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob A)))
           = rR.add (prob A) rR.zero := by simpa [h2]
  have h4 : rR.add (prob A) rR.zero = prob A := rR.add_zero (prob A)
  -- rewrite h using hcap then simplify
  have : prob (ev_union A A) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob A))) := by
    simpa [hcap]
      using h
  simpa [h3, h4]

-- Difference: P(A \ B) = P(A) - P(A ∩ B)

prob_diff.content:
theorem prob_diff (A B : event Ω) :
  prob (ev_diff A B) = prob A -R prob (ev_inter A B) := by
  -- A = (A∩B) ∪ (A∩B^c), disjoint union
  have hpart : ∀ ω, (A ω) ↔ (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ω := by
    intro ω; constructor
    · intro hA
      have hb := em (B ω)
      cases hb with
      | inl hB => exact Or.inl ⟨hA, hB⟩
      | inr hB => exact Or.inr ⟨hA, hB⟩
    · intro hU; cases hU with
      | inl hAB => exact hAB.left
      | inr hAcB => exact hAcB.left
  have hcap_disj : ∀ ω, (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ω ↔ False := by
    intro ω; constructor <;> intro h
    · rcases h with ⟨hAB, hAcB⟩; exact hAcB.right hAB.right
    · cases h
  have hAeq := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := A) (B := ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) hpart
  have hcap0 : prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) = rR.zero := by
    have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (B := ev_false) hcap_disj
    simpa [prob_false] using this
  -- Apply union formula then move terms
  have h := prob_union (prob := prob) (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))
  -- prob(A) = prob(interAB) + prob(interA¬B) - prob(∅) = sum
  have hsumA : prob A = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) := by
    -- rewrite prob A to prob of the union
    have : prob A = prob (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) := by
      simpa using hAeq
    -- expand prob of the union and simplify the empty intersection
    have hU := h
    have hzero_opp : rR.opp (prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)))) = rR.opp rR.zero := by
      simpa [hcap0]
    have hopp0 : rR.opp rR.zero = rR.zero := opp_zero
    -- Assemble
    simpa [this, hzero_opp, hopp0, rR.add_assoc, rR.add_zero]
      using hU
  -- prob(A\B) = prob(A ∩ ¬B)
  have heq_diff : prob (ev_diff A B) = prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) := by
    exact prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_diff A B) (B := ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) (by intro ω; constructor <;> intro h; exact h; exact h)
  -- Compute prob A - prob (A∩B)
  have hsub : rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))
              = prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) := by
    calc
      rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))
          = rR.add (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) := by
              simpa [hsumA]
      _ = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))) := by
              simpa using (rR.add_assoc (prob (ev_inter A B)) (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))))
      _ = rR.add (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))) (prob (ev_inter A B)) := by
              -- swap outer sum: x + (y+z) = (y+z) + x
              simpa using (rR.add_comm (prob (ev_inter A B)) (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))))
      _ = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.add (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) (prob (ev_inter A B))) := by
              simpa using (rR.add_assoc (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) (prob (ev_inter A B)))
      _ = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B)))) := by
              -- commute inner: -x + x = x + -x
              have := rR.add_comm (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) (prob (ev_inter A B))
              simpa using congrArg (fun t => rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) t) this
      _ = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) rR.zero := by
              simpa [rR.add_opp]
      _ = prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) := by
              simpa [rR.add_zero]
  simpa [heq_diff] using hsub.symm

-- Bayes identity (symmetric form)

bayes_symm.content:
theorem bayes_symm (A B : event Ω) :
  rR.mul (cprob A B) (prob B) = rR.mul (cprob B A) (prob A) := by
  -- both equal P(A ∩ B)
  calc
    rR.mul (cprob A B) (prob B) = prob (ev_inter A B) := by simpa using (cprob_mul (prob := prob) A B).symm
    _ = prob (ev_inter B A) := by
          have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter A B) (B := ev_inter B A) (ev_inter_comm A B)
          simpa using this
    _ = rR.mul (cprob B A) (prob A) := by simpa using (cprob_mul (prob := prob) B A)

-- Law of total probability for a binary partition (B, ¬B)

law_total_prob.content:
theorem law_total_prob (A B : event Ω) :
  prob A = rR.add (rR.mul (cprob A B) (prob B)) (rR.mul (cprob A (ev_compl B)) (prob (ev_compl B))) := by
  -- A = (A∩B) ∪ (A∩¬B), disjoint union -> additive
  -- From prob_diff proof we already established prob A = P(A∩B) + P(A∩¬B)
  -- Now replace with conditional form
  -- Reuse the equality derived there
  have hpart : ∀ ω, (A ω) ↔ (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ω := by
    intro ω; constructor
    · intro hA; cases em (B ω) with
      | inl hB => exact Or.inl ⟨hA, hB⟩
      | inr hB => exact Or.inr ⟨hA, hB⟩
    · intro hU; cases hU with
      | inl hAB  => exact hAB.left
      | inr hAcB => exact hAcB.left
  have hAeq := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := A) (B := ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) hpart
  have hcap0 : prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) = rR.zero := by
    have : ∀ ω, (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ω ↔ False := by
      intro ω; constructor <;> intro h
      · rcases h with ⟨hAB, hAcB⟩; exact hAcB.right hAB.right
      · cases h
    have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) (B := ev_false) this
    simpa [prob_false] using this
  have h := prob_union (prob := prob) (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))
  -- As in prob_diff, this yields P(A) = P(A∩B)+P(A∩¬B)
  have hsumA : prob A = rR.add (prob (ev_inter A B)) (prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) := by
    -- as in prob_diff
    have : prob A = prob (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) := by
      simpa using hAeq
    have hU := h
    have hzero_opp : rR.opp (prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)))) = rR.opp rR.zero := by
      simpa [hcap0]
    have hopp0 : rR.opp rR.zero = rR.zero := opp_zero
    simpa [this, hzero_opp, hopp0, rR.add_assoc, rR.add_zero]
      using hU
  -- replace intersections with conditional products
  simpa [hsumA, cprob_mul (prob := prob) A B, cprob_mul (prob := prob) A (ev_compl B)]

-- Union with independence

prob_union_indep.content:
theorem prob_union_indep (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B →
  prob (ev_union A B) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.add (prob B) (rR.opp (rR.mul (prob A) (prob B)))) := by
  intro hI
  have hU := prob_union (prob := prob) A B
  have hIeq : prob (ev_inter A B) = rR.mul (prob A) (prob B) := hI
  simpa [hIeq] using hU

-- Independence and complements

indep_compl_right.content:
theorem indep_compl_right (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) A (ev_compl B) := by
  intro hI
  -- P(A ∩ ¬B) = P(A) - P(A∩B) = P(A) - P(A)P(B) = P(A) * (1 - P(B))
  -- From prob_diff: P(A∩¬B) = P(A) - P(A∩B)
  have hdiff := prob_diff (prob := prob) A B
  have heq_diff : prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (prob (ev_inter A B))) := by
    -- ev_diff A B ≡ ev_inter A (¬B)
    have hset : prob (ev_diff A B) = prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) :=
      prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_diff A B) (B := ev_inter A (ev_compl B))
        (by intro ω; constructor <;> intro h <;> exact h)
    simpa [hset] using hdiff
  -- Use independence to substitute P(A∩B) = P(A)P(B)
  have hIeq : prob (ev_inter A B) = rR.mul (prob A) (prob B) := hI
  have hlhs : prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) = rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (rR.mul (prob A) (prob B))) := by
    simpa [hIeq]
      using heq_diff
  -- Algebra: x + - (x*y) = x*(1 + -y)
  have hdist : rR.add (rR.mul (prob A) rR.one) (rR.mul (prob A) (rR.opp (prob B)))
                = rR.mul (prob A) (rR.add rR.one (rR.opp (prob B))) := by
    simpa using (rR.dist_l (prob A) rR.one (rR.opp (prob B))).symm
  have hmul1 : rR.mul (prob A) rR.one = prob A := rR.mul_one (prob A)
  have hmul2 : rR.mul (prob A) (rR.opp (prob B)) = rR.opp (rR.mul (prob A) (prob B)) := by
    simpa using (opp_mul_right (prob A) (prob B))
  have halg : rR.add (prob A) (rR.opp (rR.mul (prob A) (prob B)))
              = rR.mul (prob A) (rR.add rR.one (rR.opp (prob B))) := by
    simpa [hmul1, hmul2] using hdist
  -- Replace prob (¬B)
  have : prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) = rR.mul (prob A) (prob (ev_compl B)) := by
    simpa [prob_compl (prob := prob) B, halg] using hlhs
  exact this

indep_symm.content:
theorem indep_symm (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) B A := by
  intro hI
  unfold indep at hI
  unfold indep
  have hcap : prob (ev_inter B A) = prob (ev_inter A B) := by
    have := prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_inter B A) (B := ev_inter A B) (ev_inter_comm B A)
    simpa using this
  have hmul : rR.mul (prob A) (prob B) = rR.mul (prob B) (prob A) := by
    simpa using (rR.mul_comm (prob A) (prob B))
  calc
    prob (ev_inter B A) = prob (ev_inter A B) := hcap
    _ = rR.mul (prob A) (prob B) := hI
    _ = rR.mul (prob B) (prob A) := by simpa using hmul

indep_compl_left.content:
theorem indep_compl_left (A B : event Ω) :
  indep (prob := prob) A B → indep (prob := prob) (ev_compl A) B := by
  intro hI
  -- Use symmetry twice
  have hBA : indep (prob := prob) B A := indep_symm (prob := prob) A B hI
  have hBnotA : indep (prob := prob) B (ev_compl A) :=
    indep_compl_right (prob := prob) B A hBA
  exact indep_symm (prob := prob) B (ev_compl A) hBnotA

prob_bigUnion_disjoint.content:
theorem prob_bigUnion_disjoint :
  ∀ (xs : mylist (event Ω)), pairwise_disjoint xs →
    prob (bigUnion xs) = mylist.fold_add rR.add rR.zero (mylist.mapL prob xs)
| mylist.nilL, _ => by simpa [bigUnion, mylist.fold_add, mylist.mapL, prob_false]
| (A ::L mylist.nilL), _ => by
    -- bigUnion [A] ≡ A
    have hunionA : prob (ev_union A ev_false) = prob A :=
      prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_union A ev_false) (B := A)
        (by
          intro ω; constructor
          · intro h; cases h with
            | inl hA => exact hA
            | inr hf => exact False.elim hf
          · intro hA; exact Or.inl hA)
    simpa [bigUnion, mylist.fold_add, mylist.mapL, prob_false, rR.add_zero, hunionA]
| (A ::L (B ::L xs)), hpair => by
    rcases hpair with ⟨hAB, hrest, hpw⟩
    -- A is disjoint from bigUnion of tail (axiom)
    have hAdisj : disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs)) :=
      disjoint_head_tail A (B ::L xs) (by exact And.intro hAB (And.intro hrest hpw))
    -- Use disjoint union additivity axiom and IH on tail
    have hU' : prob (bigUnion (A ::L (B ::L xs))) = rR.add (prob A) (prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs))) := by
      simpa [bigUnion] using (prob_union_disjoint (prob := prob) A (bigUnion (B ::L xs)) hAdisj)
    have htail := prob_bigUnion_disjoint (B ::L xs) hpw
    have hsum : prob (bigUnion (A ::L (B ::L xs)))
              = rR.add (prob A) (mylist.fold_add rR.add rR.zero (mylist.mapL prob (B ::L xs))) := by
      simpa [htail] using hU'
    simpa [bigUnion, mylist.mapL, mylist.fold_add, rR.add_assoc] using hsum

-- Zero on disjoint union of zero-probability events

prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero.content:
theorem prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero :
  ∀ (xs : mylist (event Ω)), pairwise_disjoint xs →
    (∀ A, InL A xs → prob A = rR.zero) → prob (bigUnion xs) = rR.zero
| mylist.nilL, _, _ => by simpa [bigUnion, prob_false]
| (A ::L mylist.nilL), hp, hzero => by
    have hA0 : prob A = rR.zero := hzero A (InL.In_head mylist.nilL)
    -- bigUnion [A] ≡ A
    have hunionA : prob (ev_union A ev_false) = prob A :=
      prob_ext (prob := prob) (A := ev_union A ev_false) (B := A)
        (by
          intro ω; constructor
          · intro h; cases h with
            | inl hA => exact hA
            | inr hf => exact False.elim hf
          · intro hA; exact Or.inl hA)
    simpa [bigUnion, hunionA, hA0, rR.add_zero, prob_false]
| (A ::L (B ::L xs)), hp, hzero => by
    -- decompose pairwise info
    rcases hp with ⟨hAB, hrest, hpw⟩
    -- A is disjoint from bigUnion tail
    have hAdisj : disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs)) := disjoint_head_tail A (B ::L xs) (by exact And.intro hAB (And.intro hrest hpw))
    have hA0 : prob A = rR.zero := hzero A (InL.In_head _)
    have htail0 : (∀ C, InL C (B ::L xs) → prob C = rR.zero) := by
      intro C hC; exact hzero C (InL.In_tail (y := A) (xs := B ::L xs) hC)
    have htail := prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero (B ::L xs) hpw htail0
    have hU : prob (bigUnion (A ::L (B ::L xs))) = rR.add (prob A) (prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs))) := by
      simpa [bigUnion] using (prob_union_disjoint (prob := prob) A (bigUnion (B ::L xs)) hAdisj)
    -- RHS becomes 0 + 0 = 0
    have hsum00 : rR.add (prob A) (prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs))) = rR.add rR.zero rR.zero := by
      simpa [hA0, htail]
    have : prob (bigUnion (A ::L (B ::L xs))) = rR.add rR.zero rR.zero := by
      simpa [hsum00] using hU
    have hz : rR.add rR.zero rR.zero = rR.zero := by simpa [rR.add_zero]
    simpa [this, hz]

mapL.content:

prob_ext.content:
Axiom prob_ext : forall A B, (forall w, A w <-> B w) -> prob A = prob B.
  Axiom prob_false : prob ev_false = zero.
  Axiom prob_true  : prob ev_true  = one.
  Axiom prob_union : forall A B,
    prob (ev_union A B) = prob A +R (prob B +R -R (prob (ev_inter A B))).
  Axiom prob_compl : forall A, prob (ev_compl A) = one +R -R (prob A).
  (* Classical excluded middle for event case splits *)
  Axiom classic : forall P:Prop, P \/ ~ P.

fold_add.content:
Fixpoint fold_add (xs : mylist R) : R :=
    match xs with
    | nilL => zero
    | consL x xs' => x +R fold_add xs'
    end.

prob_union_comm.content:
Lemma prob_union_comm A B :
    prob (ev_union A B) = prob (ev_union B A).
  Proof.
    apply prob_ext; intro w; split; intro HU; destruct HU as [HA|HB];
    [right|left|right|left]; assumption.
  Qed.

prob_union_idem.content:
Lemma prob_union_idem A : prob (ev_union A A) = prob A.
  Proof.
    specialize (prob_union A A). intro HU.
    assert (Heq : prob (ev_inter A A) = prob A).
    { apply prob_ext; intro w; split; intro HX; [exact (proj1 HX)|split; [exact HX|exact HX]]. }
    rewrite HU. rewrite Heq.
    rewrite add_opp. rewrite add_zero. reflexivity.
  Qed.

prob_diff.content:
Lemma prob_diff A B : prob (ev_diff A B) = prob A -R prob (ev_inter A B).
  Proof.
    assert (Hpart : forall w, A w <-> (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) w).
    { intro w. split.
      - intro hA. destruct (classic (B w)) as [hB|hNB].
        + left. split; assumption.
        + right. split; assumption.
      - intros [ [hA _] | [hA _] ]; exact hA. }
    assert (Hcap0 : prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) = zero).
    { rewrite (prob_ext (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ev_false).
      - apply prob_false.
      - intro w. split; intro Hcap; [destruct Hcap as [[? ?] [? Hnb]]; contradiction| contradiction]. }
    pose proof (prob_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) as Hunion.
    (* Replace prob A by the union decomposition *)
    rewrite (prob_ext A (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) Hpart).
    (* Expand prob (union) and simplify empty intersection *)
    rewrite Hunion. rewrite Hcap0. rewrite opp_zero.
    (* Now RHS is (pAB + (pA¬B + 0)) - pAB = pA¬B *)
    rewrite add_zero.
    (* Rearrange to cancel pAB *)
    rewrite add_comm with (x:=prob (ev_inter A B)) (y:=prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))).
    rewrite add_assoc.
    rewrite add_opp. rewrite add_zero.
    (* Replace diff by intersection with complement *)
    unfold ev_diff. apply prob_ext. intro w. split; intro HX; exact HX.
  Qed.

bayes_symm.content:
Lemma bayes_symm A B : cprob A B *R prob B = cprob B A *R prob A.
  Proof.
    rewrite <- cprob_mul. apply eq_trans with (y:=prob (ev_inter B A)).
    - apply prob_ext; intro w; split; intro HBA; destruct HBA as [h1 h2]; [split; [exact h2|exact h1]|split; [exact h2|exact h1]].
    - apply cprob_mul.
  Qed.

law_total_prob.content:
Lemma law_total_prob A B :
    prob A = cprob A B *R prob B +R cprob A (ev_compl B) *R prob (ev_compl B).
  Proof.
    pose proof (prob_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) as Hunion.
    assert (Hpart : forall w, A w <-> (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) w).
    { intro w. split.
      - intro hA. destruct (classic (B w)) as [hB|hNB].
        + left. split; assumption.
        + right. split; assumption.
      - intros [ [hA _] | [hA _] ]; exact hA. }
    rewrite (prob_ext A (ev_union (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) Hpart).
    rewrite Hunion.
    assert (Hcap0 : prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) = zero).
    { rewrite (prob_ext (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) (ev_inter A (ev_compl B))) ev_false).
      - apply prob_false.
      - intro w. split; intro Hcap; [destruct Hcap as [[? ?] [? Hnb]]; contradiction| contradiction]. }
    rewrite Hcap0. rewrite opp_zero. rewrite add_zero.
    rewrite cprob_mul. rewrite cprob_mul. reflexivity.
  Qed.

prob_union_indep.content:
Lemma prob_union_indep A B : indep A B ->
    prob (ev_union A B) = prob A +R (prob B +R -R (prob A *R prob B)).
  Proof. intro Hin. unfold indep in Hin. rewrite prob_union. now rewrite Hin. Qed.

indep_symm.content:
Lemma indep_symm A B : indep A B -> indep B A.
  Proof.
    intro Hin. unfold indep in *.
    rewrite (prob_ext (ev_inter B A) (ev_inter A B)).
    - rewrite mul_comm. exact Hin.
    - intro w. split; intro Hba; destruct Hba as [h1 h2]; [split; [exact h2|exact h1]|split; [exact h2|exact h1]].
  Qed.

indep_compl_right.content:
Lemma indep_compl_right A B : indep A B -> indep A (ev_compl B).
  Proof.
    intro Hin. unfold indep.
    (* Convert intersection with complement to set difference *)
    assert (HeqID : prob (ev_inter A (ev_compl B)) = prob (ev_diff A B)).
    { apply prob_ext. intro w. split; intro Hw; exact Hw. }
    rewrite HeqID.
    (* Use difference identity and independence *)
    rewrite prob_diff. rewrite Hin.
    (* Compute complement probability and distribute *)
    rewrite prob_compl. rewrite dist_l. rewrite mul_one. rewrite opp_mul_right. reflexivity.
  Qed.

indep_compl_left.content:
Lemma indep_compl_left A B : indep A B -> indep (ev_compl A) B.
  Proof. intro Hin. apply indep_symm. apply indep_symm in Hin. now apply indep_compl_right. Qed.

prob_bigUnion_disjoint.content:
Lemma prob_bigUnion_disjoint : forall xs,
    pairwise_disjoint xs -> prob (bigUnion xs) = fold_add (mapL prob xs).
  Proof.
    intros xs HPD.
    induction HPD as [
      | A
      | A B xs Hdisj Hrest HPW IH
    ].
    - simpl. apply prob_false.
    - simpl.
      assert (Hun : prob (ev_union A ev_false) = prob A).
      { apply prob_ext. intro w. split; intro HU;
        [destruct HU as [hA|hF]; [assumption|contradiction] | now left]. }
      simpl. rewrite Hun. rewrite add_zero. reflexivity.
    -
      assert (HAd : disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs))).
      { apply disjoint_head_tail. constructor; assumption. }
      change (prob (ev_union A (bigUnion (B ::L xs))) = prob A +R fold_add (mapL prob (B ::L xs))).
      rewrite (prob_union_disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs)) HAd).
      rewrite IH. reflexivity.
  Qed.

prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero.content:
Lemma prob_bigUnion_disjoint_zero : forall xs,
    pairwise_disjoint xs -> (forall A, InL A xs -> prob A = zero) -> prob (bigUnion xs) = zero.
  Proof.
    intros xs HPD HZ.
    induction HPD as [
      | A
      | A B xs Hdisj Hrest HPW IH
    ].
    - simpl. apply prob_false.
    - simpl.
      assert (Hun : prob (ev_union A ev_false) = prob A).
      { apply prob_ext. intro w. split; intro HU;
        [destruct HU as [hA|hF]; [assumption|contradiction] | now left]. }
      rewrite Hun. apply HZ. constructor.
    -
      assert (HAd : disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs))).
      { apply disjoint_head_tail. constructor; assumption. }
      change (prob (ev_union A (bigUnion (B ::L xs))) = zero).
      rewrite (prob_union_disjoint A (bigUnion (B ::L xs)) HAd).
      (* prob A = 0 from HZ on head *)
      rewrite (HZ A (@In_head event A (B ::L xs))).
      (* reduce 0 + prob (bigUnion tail) *)
      rewrite add_comm with (x:=zero) (y:=prob (bigUnion (B ::L xs))).
      rewrite add_zero.
      (* now use IH for the tail with restricted hypothesis *)
      apply IH. intros C Hin. apply HZ. apply In_tail; assumption.
  Qed.

inclusion_exclusion_three.content:
Axiom inclusion_exclusion_three : forall A B C,
    prob (ev_union (ev_union A B) C)
      = prob A +R (prob B +R (prob C +R -R (prob (ev_inter A B) +R (prob (ev_inter A C) +R (prob (ev_inter B C) +R -R (prob (ev_inter (ev_inter A B) C))))))).
